name: Bvlgari Hotel Paris
positioning: Bvlgari Hotel Paris, a Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts property with an Italian restaurant led by Chef Niko Romito and a spa open to hotel residents and local clients
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-focused stay
Couples looking for a private spa suite
Guests who enjoy Italian dining and an aperitivo bar

facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito at Bvlgari Hotel Paris is led by Chef Niko Romito.
The Bvlgari Bar has black granite floors, a high-gloss ceiling and brass accents.
The Bvlgari Bar serves aperitivo in the classic Italian way, with bites and antipasti.
The Bvlgari Lounge has marble tables and serves Afternoon Tea.
The Bvlgari Spa is open to hotel residents and local clients.
The Spa Suite design is inspired by the Dome of the Roman Pantheon.
Each spa treatment room has its own shower.
The spa reception is finished in green onyx.
The fitness space is open around the clock and curated by Workshop Gymnasium.

highlights.text: The Spa Suite is designed for couples and has two treatment tables, a private hydromassage and a hammam.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is hidden in a private garden.
The pool is lined with emerald, jade and malachite mosaics rippled with gold.
The Bvlgari Spa is clad in Vicenza stone from Veneto, Italy, and Burmese teak.
The private dining room is furnished entirely with Antonio Citterio designs and sits next to the garden.

considerations.text: The spa is also open to local clients, not only hotel residents.
WhataHotel notes that ultra-luxury pricing reflects the exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes that the intimate boutique size may mean limited availability.
